fields.name: conditional_tool_families
fields.notes: [{group, tools[], available:bool}] — worker-routed families flagged by availability

fields.name: ok
fields.notes: true iff every declared asset resolved inside the token namespace

fields.name: delivery_ready
fields.notes: false when any assertion fails; a transport-valid but empty artifact is NOT delivery-ready

fields.name: checked
fields.notes: {expected_files, expected_media, required_text, non_empty} echoed with per-item pass/fail

fields.name: why
fields.notes: the observable fingerprint: bad-shape id / grain-mismatch zero-element / first unbounded sweep

fields.name: correct_primitive
fields.notes: the primitive the caller should have used (e.g. bodesign_workspace_inspect)

fields.name: remedy
fields.notes: {note} — single-source from _skill_nudge, projected to portable content text via _render_remedy_line equivalent
